title: I built a no-code strategy builder inside TradingView that layers logic on top of your existing indicators. Looking for feedback.
author: Adorable_You516

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the uptrend filter is where I'd look first. if it reads a higher timeframe through request.security without lookahead off and a [1] offset, the backtest sees the daily close mid-session and every confirm looks great. worth a line in the docs saying how Builder Lab handles that.

replies.author: Adorable_You516
replies.body:
>**Totally agree, thanks for pointing this out!**  
Just to be clear, Builder Lab doesn't actually employ any MTF/lookahead functions under the hood. The tool itself is clean.  
That said, it’s a great reminder that it's ultimately up to the strategy builders to carefully vetting their own indicator logic for repainting traps. I'll make sure to drop a dedicated warning in the docs so users are fully aware of this responsibility. Cheers!

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: good to hear the engine side is clean. the user side is where I'd expect it to bite: someone pulls a higher timeframe close into a lower timeframe rule and the chart looks great right up until it trades.
